browser and social/email "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"accounts by their owner. It hardens the one tool that

payloads, offsite beacons and inline `data:` "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"blobs) is stripped **before** it

| L2 | **Sanitize** raw HTML: drop `<script>/<styl"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"e>/<noscript>/<template>/<iframe>/<head>/<embed>`, hidden CSS & hidden attrs, offsite images, `data:"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"` URIs; flatten to safe text | `lib/sanitize.js` |

`assistant/message` that echoes on"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"e.
- On a leak it `console.warn`s and appends a `system/message` injection alert
